source.name: 懂球帝 via 网易号 (Dongqiudi via NetEase): 记者：青岛西海岸新赛季球衣广告位增加灵山岛、竹岔岛等元素 (Reporter: Qingdao West Coast's new-season shirt ads add Lingshan Island, Zhucha Island and other elements)
source.quote: 西海岸新赛季战袍的胸前广告位增加了“金沙滩啤酒城”的字样，背后广告位则增加了“灵山岛、竹岔岛”的字样
source.note: Translation: 'On West Coast's new-season shirt, the chest advertising slot added the words "Golden Beach Beer City", and the back advertising slot added the words "Lingshan Island, Zhucha Island".' The article cites Qingdao Daily reporter Sun Fei, reporting on photos posted on social media by the club's foreign player Davidson. The club's 4 March 2026 season-launch ceremony presented the same double-advertising arrangement (Sohu, 2026-03-05, https://www.sohu.com/a/992784493_121612292: '胸前广告位印上青岛地标 “金沙滩啤酒城”，背后广告位则铺满 “灵山岛、竹岔岛” 文旅元素').

source.name: 先锋新闻 via 网易号, sourcing 大河报 (Xianfeng News via NetEase, sourcing Dahe Daily): 中超青岛双雄海牛和西海岸，新赛季球衣正式发布 (CSL's two Qingdao clubs, Hainiu and West Coast, officially release new-season shirts)
source.quote: 今天，运动品牌耐克正式公布2026赛季中超联赛16支俱乐部的球衣，并配文官方设计思路。
source.note: Translation: 'Today, sports brand Nike officially released the shirts of the 16 clubs of the 2026 CSL season, with official design notes.' Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The same release describes Qingdao West Coast's home shirt: '新赛季青岛西海岸队主场战袍，以明亮黄调为主色并辅以渐进晕染设计，搭配深邃黑色细节勾勒轮廓' (bright yellow with a gradient and deep-black details).

summary: Nike home kit for the 2026 CSL season (bright yellow with a gradient and black details, released 28 January 2026). The match shirt carries Golden Beach Beer City (金沙滩啤酒城), the West Coast New Area beer-festival venue, on the chest and Lingshan Island / Zhucha Island tourism branding on the back, shown at the club's 4 March 2026 season-launch ceremony and reported by Qingdao Daily's reporter. Not complete: no openable source documents a sleeve, shorts or league-badge sponsor for 2026, and the club's 2024 sleeve sponsor (Qingdao Jintianxinke) has not been confirmed to continue.
